hints.title: Inventory Item Frequency
hints.text: Count the total number of items belonging to each category.

hints.title: Surplus Identification
hints.text: Whenever a category's count exceeds maxAllowed, the difference represents surplus discards.

hints.title: Total Discard Accumulation
hints.text: Sum the surplus items across all categories.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: U: number of unique inventory types
complexity.notes: Single pass frequency counting with surplus aggregation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated scans over inventory take quadratic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Count frequencies and sum excess items above threshold.
